needs.proposedSignature: { op: 'choose-mode'; modes: Effect[][]; count: Amount; repeat?: boolean; upTo?: boolean; notChosen?: 'this-turn' | 'ever'; weights?: number[] } — the CORE modal op gains the family flags, and legal.ts:modeCombos(n, k) enumerates k-combinations (k-MULTIsets when `repeat`) instead of the pairs it returns today for every k >= 2
needs.semantics: A modal spell whose modes take targets and whose header says 'Choose three' / 'You may choose the same mode more than once' / 'choose up to five {P} worth of modes'. The core op already expands the chosen modes into the item's effect list before targets are chosen (legal.ts:expandModes), so a mode's `counter` / `bounce` / `damage` keeps a real target; today only the family `choose-modes` can say `repeat` / `weights` / `notChosen`, and its modes are never offered a target because legal.ts:nestedLists does not descend into a family op's lists. Either descend into `choose-modes.modes` for targeting (asking for every mode's targets at cast, CR 601.2b) or lift the flags onto the core op.
needs.clause: Choose three. You may choose the same mode more than once. • Counter target spell unless its controller pays {3}.
